## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the extension-units computation has no honest `method` factor.** (Charter-global finding F-2 in `_difficulty.md` § factor_ladders / § findings; demonstrated here.)
   - Symptom: the only factor labelled `method` in `auth_ext_extension_units`, `remaining_units_deduction`, substitutes a rate into one formula.
   - Root cause: factor declaration auth.extended.yaml lines 2885-2899 (`effect: method`) over compute line 2840 `ex_deduction: "0 if (…) else (ex_remaining // 2 if (…) else ex_remaining)"`.
   - Evidence: the three tiers are `floor(f × ex_remaining)` with f = 0, ½, 1 — "nothing is deducted" / "half of the units remaining, rounded down" / "all of the units remaining are deducted"; the quantity is computed the same way in every tier, only the fraction changes (the skill's definition of `parameter`: "a factor labelled `method` whose tiers only substitute a different number into the same formula (a rate …)").
   - Demonstrated consequence: counting only honest labels, the computation scored at step 21 (`units_added` = 11) has 6 `parameter` factors and 0 `method` factors, below the per-computation floor of 1. The factor still bears weight (baseline 9 ≠ 11) — the defect is the missing method-kind variation, not decoration.
   - Affected: auth.extended.yaml `auth_ext_extension_units.factors[remaining_units_deduction]`; computations[3] of this task (step 21).
   - Relation to previous revisions: first audit round.
2. Observation (F-2, second instance): `auth_ext_member_extension_request.factors[remaining_units_deduction]` (lines 2674-2688) is the same rate substitution labelled `method`; the computation keeps one honest `method` (`request_weeks`), so its count holds.
3. Observation (O-5): the extension rule says units are added "within … the annual limit the class sets" and base auth_agg_annual_limit caps an extension at the units left; compute has no such bound. On this world units left = 30 − (12 + 8 − 1) = 11 = the computed 11, so no scored consequence.
4. Observation: persona says he goes to Salt Creek "now", yet a paid Riverbend visit is on 2026-09-22; says he has not been to Capitol "since the middle of August", yet a Capitol claim is dated 2026-08-24 and a ride to Capitol was booked 2026-09-18 for 2026-09-29. None of these is a persona-supplied fact a gold write consumes.
5. Observation: "You mention that you moved" volunteers background that points toward the provider change; the clinic and NPI are withheld until asked, so the prerequisite is not named.
